items.name: osmanthus honey matcha latte
items.description: Golden, floral, and gently sweet 🌼 a sip of warmth and good fortune to welcome the lunar new year. Brewed with premium osmanthus flowers and halal Australia honey.

items.name: Bandung Matcha Latte
items.description: Dreamy, floral rose syrup blended with smooth matcha, celebrate SG60 with a sip that feels like home 🇸🇬

items.name: OG Matcha Latte
items.description: Indulge in a luxurious latte made with the finest ceremonial grade Japanese matcha, offering a rich, creamy texture.

items.name: Strawberry Matcha Latte
items.description: Sip a delightful fusion of sweet strawberries and rich Japanese matcha, layered with milk for a refreshing and flavorful matcha latte experience.

items.name: Biscoff Matcha Latte
items.description: Dangerously addictive — swirl up our OG matcha with biscoff for a silky, dessert-like treat in a cup. Sweet and satisfyingly toasty with a hint of cinnamon, it’s a flavour combo you didn’t know you needed 🍵🍪💚

items.name: Kaya Matcha Latte
items.description: Creamy, earthy matcha blended with rich, fragrant kaya for the ultimate nostalgic twist. It’s sweet, smooth, and straight-up shiok.

items.name: Classic Usucha
items.description: Traditional Japanese thin matcha that offers a delicate balance of earthy, slightly grassy flavors with a light, refreshing finish. Perfect for those who enjoy an authentic, minimalist matcha experience.

items.name: Sparkling Yuzu Usucha
items.description: A refreshing blend of zesty yuzu and premium matcha, infused with sparkling bubbles for the ultimate fizzy pick-me-up! Available in non-sparkling too.

items.name: Bottled Matcha
items.description: Stock up on your fave bottled matcha/hojicha lattes! From our OG classic to fruity, floral, and indulgent flavours. Chilled, ready to sip, and made with ceremonial grade matcha for that smooth, rich kick. 💚

items.name: Salted Caramel Hojicha Latte
items.description: Enjoy a rich and toasty dark roast hojicha latte with deep, nutty flavors drizzled with salted caramel sauce for that smooth, aromatic sweet finish.

items.name: Hojicha Latte
items.description: Enjoy a rich and toasty dark roast hojicha latte with deep, nutty flavors and a smooth, aromatic sweet finish.

items.name: Tofu Muffin
items.description: Made with fresh tofu and soy milk, these soft, tofu muffins are 100% eggless and freshly baked for the perfect wholesome treat.
